name: transcript-intelligence
title_zh: 九平台视频转文字，钩子金句脚本一次拆完
tagline_zh: TikTok到Reddit，一条视频拆出钩子、论点、金句、内容原子和可复用脚本。不用自己拉片三遍。
tagline_en: From TikTok to Reddit, one pass extracts hooks, claims, quotes, content atoms, and reusable scripts—no manual.
desc_en: Use when the user wants to summarize, analyze, or repurpose transcripts from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, X/Twitter, LinkedIn, Rumble, or Reddit video posts. Extracts hooks, claims, quotes, content atoms, themes, and reusable scripts.
why_zh: 不是简单转写，而是按内容结构拆解：钩子怎么开场、论点怎么支撑、哪句能截出来当引文。
why_en: Not just transcription—it structurally dissects content into hooks, claims, quotable lines, and atoms, giving you a.
limit_zh: 只吃视频帖的公开转写文本，不含评论区分析；拆解深度依赖原视频字幕质量，无声或纯音乐视频会拆出空壳。
limit_en: Only processes public video transcripts, not comments; output quality depends on original captions—silent or music-only videos yield empty shells.
title_en: Turn 9 platforms' videos into hooks, claims, scripts
